extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO; counsel handling USPTO enrollment/discipline matters
extracted.subtask_description: Procedure for filing and obtaining reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office, including submission of an affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 and review by the Office of Enrollment and Discipline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: A Petition for Reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office must be filed (example petition received March 26, 2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The petition is subject to consideration by the Office of Enrollment and Discipline; after review the Director may determine that reinstatement is appropriate and grant the petition. Include clear filing date and ensure timely submission according to applicable procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: An Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 must be filed in support of the petition for reinstatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The supporting affidavit is a regulatory requirement cited by the Office; it should comply with the content and form expectations of 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 (the decision references the affidavit as part of the basis for review).

rubrics_metrics.name: Review and decision authority
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline reviews the petition and supporting affidavit and determines whether reinstatement is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decisions are made after 'careful review' of the petition and affidavit; the decision may be issued by the Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline and Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline, and will state whether the petition is granted or denied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service / Notice of decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Copies of the decision are provided to the petitioner and counsel of record (example: copy to Ms. Carla Miller, The Miller Firm).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include counsel contact details for service; the decision document typically lists counsel name, firm, and mailing address for notification purposes.
